title: AcademicCapabilityProfileContract
description: Contract schema for tracking multidimensional capability bounds, verified topologies, and empirical limitations across academic tasks.

profile_id.description: Unique identifier for this capability profile (e.g. CAP-SEM-001).

capability_key.description: Canonical capability identifier matching orchestrator dependency resolver (e.g. sem, cfa, mediation, apa_reporting).

primary_agent.description: Specialist subagent bound to this capability (e.g. statistics-agent, academic-writer).

primary_skill.description: Production skill in .agents/skills/ bound to this capability.

known_limitations.description: Empirically identified boundary conditions where this capability degrades (e.g. N < 150 in SEM, severe multicollinearity VIF > 10).

supported_topologies.description: Statistical designs and model configurations supported with high confidence (e.g. recursive path models, multi-group CFA, PROCESS Model 4).
